name: print-social-grey-paper-app-mvp-five-screens-cover-post
title: App MVP Five Screens Cover
whatItIs: A grainy grey carousel cover with a heavy 'App MVP ?' headline, a subhead 'Start with these 5 screens' with a large 5, and a phone showing a headphone product menu cropped at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Big black type and a cropped phone are a clear hook, and the question invites a swipe.
techniques: Huge heavy headline with a question mark
Phone cropped at the base to imply more
Grain texture on a flat grey
Small series header and site link

vocabulary.definition: A first slide designed to stop the scroll.
Making a figure larger than the words around it.
Letting an object run off the edge of the frame.
